days.title: Day 1 | Arrival In Hanoi & Transfer To Sapa | Evening At Leisure
activities: Arrival at Hanoi Noi Bai International Airport and welcome by your tour coordinator.
Board the comfortable limousine sleeper coach for the scenic journey to the misty mountain town of Sapa.
Drive along the scenic northern expressway through the Red River Delta and into the mountains.
Arrive in Sapa town nestled beneath the Hoang Lien Son range; check in at your hotel.
Evening free to explore the iconic Sapa Stone Church, bustling night market, and hillside cafes.
Overnight stay in Sapa.

days.title: Day 2 | Sapa Tour: Fansipan Peak, Glass Bridge & Cat Cat Village
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Ride the Muong Hoa Funicular across scenic terraced rice valleys to the cable car station.
Ascend via the Sun World cable car to Fansipan Peak (3,143m), known as the 'Roof of Indochina'.
Explore the grand mountain pagodas, giant Amitabha Buddha, and panoramic viewing decks above the clouds.
Relish a delicious buffet lunch included at the mountain restaurant.
Walk on the Rong May Glass Bridge suspended along cliff faces for an adrenaline rush and breathtaking valley views.
Afternoon trek to Cat Cat Village, home to the Black H'mong ethnic community, with waterfalls and traditional watermills.
Return to your hotel; overnight stay in Sapa.

days.title: Day 3 | Sapa to Hanoi & Half-Day Hanoi City Tour
activities: Breakfast at the hotel and check-out.
Board the limousine bus for the return scenic journey back down to Hanoi.
Arrive in Hanoi by early afternoon and check in to your hotel.
Half-day Hanoi city tour: visit the historic Temple of Literature, Vietnam's first national university.
Explore the picturesque Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, and the vibrant maze of the 36 Old Quarter streets.
Evening free to enjoy dinner at local bistros or sample traditional Pho and egg coffee.
Overnight stay in Hanoi.

days.title: Day 4 | Ha Long Bay Luxury Day Cruise, Kayaking & Buffet Lunch
activities: Early breakfast at the hotel followed by morning transfer to Tuan Chau Port in Halong Bay.
Board the luxury day cruise and set sail through the UNESCO World Heritage seascape.
Enjoy a lavish international and fresh seafood buffet lunch while gliding past iconic limestone islets.
Explore Sung Sot (Surprise) Cave, filled with breathtaking stalactites and illuminated caverns.
Kayaking or bamboo boat ride through Luon Cave into a tranquil emerald lagoon.
Stop at Titov Island to climb the panoramic viewpoint or relax and swim on the sandy beach.
Enjoy a sunset tea party on the sundeck as the cruise heads back to the harbor.
Transfer back to Hanoi in the evening; overnight stay in Hanoi.

days.title: Day 5 | Hanoi to Da Nang | Flight Transfer & Evening at Leisure
activities: Breakfast at the hotel and check-out.
Transfer to Hanoi Airport for your flight to the coastal city of Da Nang.
Arrival at Da Nang Airport and transfer to your beachfront hotel.
Afternoon at leisure to soak in the sun at My Khe Beach.
Visit the Son Tra Peninsula and marvel at the 67-meter tall Lady Buddha statue at Linh Ung Pagoda.
Evening leisure walk to view the illuminated Dragon Bridge spanning the Han River.
Overnight stay in Da Nang.

days.title: Day 6 | Marble Mountains, Coconut Forest, Hoi An & Lantern Boat Ride
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Morning tour of the Marble Mountains (Ngu Hanh Son) to explore hidden Buddhist shrines inside natural grottos.
Visit Cam Thanh Coconut Forest and take an exciting round bamboo basket boat ride with local rowing stunts.
Head to the UNESCO World Heritage town of Hoi An.
Stroll through historic lantern-lit alleys, visiting the 400-year-old Japanese Covered Bridge and old merchant residences.
Take an evening boat ride on the Hoai River to release paper flower candle lanterns for good fortune.
Time for shopping at Hoi An Night Market for silk lanterns, leather goods, and local treats.
Return to Da Nang; overnight stay in Da Nang.

days.title: Day 7 | Ba Na Hills Full Day: Cable Car, Golden Bridge & Fantasy Park
activities: Breakfast at the hotel.
Transfer to Sun World Ba Na Hills and board the world's longest single-rope cable car.
Walk along the world-renowned Golden Bridge supported by gigantic stone hands high above the clouds.
Tour the French Village with its European architecture, Le Jardin D'Amour gardens, and the Debay Wine Cellar.
Enjoy unlimited games, 4D/5D cinema, and rides at the indoor Fantasy Park.
Visit the mountain Linh Ung Pagoda with its 27m high seated Shakyamuni Buddha.
Descend by cable car in the late afternoon and return to Da Nang.
Overnight stay in Da Nang.

days.title: Day 8 | Da Nang Leisure & Airport Departure
activities: Breakfast at the hotel and morning at leisure for beachside walks or souvenir shopping.
Complete hotel check-out.
Private transfer to Da Nang International Airport for your scheduled return flight.
Depart with cherished memories of your incredible journey across Vietnam.
